name: project-setup
description: Prepares a repository for agentpipe: writes agentpipe.json (the lint and unit test commands that work here) and AGENTPIPE.md (guidance every agent reads). Queued automatically for new projects.
when_to_use: Once per new project whose repository has no agentpipe.json, or when a project's commands or conventions changed so much that the file and notes are wrong. Not for code changes.
inputs: What the project is for; anything known about its toolchain.
outputs: A branch with agentpipe.json and AGENTPIPE.md at the repository root, checked by running the commands it wrote.
